---
title: "Elizabeth Redgrave - The Word and the Work, or, The Harmony of Scripture with Geological Discoveries"
book_id: 1119
---

## Publication Information

**Date:** 1860

**Imprint:** London: Mozley

**Notes:** This work was described in 'Hints on Reading', <i>MP</i> (January 1860), 111, as 'a series of conversations between a clergyman and a mechanic, intended to popularize Hugh Miller's views of the Periods of Creation, and to show how they may be reconciled with the Scriptural narrative.'
